parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run for the request to check information such as the permissions and instance status. Valid values:

*   true: performs a dry run for the request, but does not create a service instance.
*   false: performs a dry run for the request, and creates a service instance if the request passes the dry run.

parameters.name: Option
parameters.description: The options that the system adopts when the system continues to create the service instance.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The parameters configured for the service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest continue-deploy-service-instance --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --service-instance-id si-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --parameters NodeCount_:_3,_SystemDiskSize_:_40,_InstancePassword_:_000000 --dry-run false --option TryToFixSignalFailureByRerunEcsCommand --region cn-hangzhou
